opening: Happy Sunday, friend. This week we've got a question that's lighting up the community inbox, a survival guide for your next family dinner, and something Sarah found in the sleep research that honestly surprised us. Grab your coffee and let's get into it.

hero.title: Does Sky-High LDL on Carnivore Clog Arteries?
hero.teaser: Your LDL spikes on carnivore and suddenly everyone from your doctor to your aunt has an opinion. Sarah digs into the actual trial data, including one study that got retracted after the headlines ran. The science is messier than either side wants to admit, and the answer isn't what you're expecting from either camp.
hero.cta: Read before your next doctor visit

supporting.title: The Nutrients Muscle-Meat-Only Carnivore Misses
supporting.teaser: Sarah names the specific nutrients that steak alone won't cover, and the one food that quietly fixes most of the list.

supporting.title: Carnivore Week 2 Strength Dip: Why It Happens and the Fix
supporting.teaser: Marcus explains the exact week-2 wall that's tanking your lifts, and why pushing through it the wrong way makes it worse.

supporting.title: Being the Only Carnivore at Family Dinner: A Survival Guide
supporting.teaser: Chloe's got the word-for-word scripts for the relative who wants to debate your arteries before the salad's even passed.

try_this_week: Add one organ meat this week. You don't have to go all-in. A single beef liver serving, even just 3 to 4 ounces mixed into ground beef, covers the gaps Sarah outlines in this week's nutrient post. Cook it tonight and you've done something most carnivores skip entirely.
looking_ahead: Next week we're looking at something community members keep asking about: whether your meal timing on carnivore actually matters, or if that's just an old bodybuilding rule dressed up in new clothes.
